Title: Search Tools Roadmap
Content: Search is central to MemorySmith's usefulness. Lexical search is now the default baseline and uses Lucene.NET StandardAnalyzer tokenization with weighted title/tag/reference/content scoring; semantic search has an optional ONNX embedding ranker with local token-scoring fallback; hybrid search combines Lucene.NET lexical analysis with the active semantic signal using reciprocal rank fusion (RRF). MCP context packs turn hybrid roots plus references/conflicts/backlinks into bounded agent-ready bundles for larger KB workflows. Next search roadmap items are durable/cached vector indexing, page embeddings, structured JSON output for search MCP tools, graph validation, model asset validation, and performance thresholds while preserving the existing lexical, semantic, hybrid, and context-pack API shapes.
